details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It is published as a scoped name at a sentinel version (99.0.0) with a near-empty tarball, and its package.json runs a preinstall hook (`node preinstall.js`) that folds the installer's hostname into a DNS label and resolves it against an attacker-controlled callback domain — a DNS-only beacon that needs no HTTP egress. preinstall.js reads os.hostname(), replaces non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, truncates to 60 characters, and calls dns.resolve() on the result suffixed with.ngp-ui[.]auth-client[.]oob[.]jr0ch17[.]com (e.g. <hostname>.ngp-ui[.]auth-client[.]oob[.]jr0ch17[.]com, resolved as an A record). The remainder of the package is inert: index.js contains only a comment identifying it as authorized security-testing artifact and exports an empty object. Only the host name is transmitted; the hook does not read credentials, tokens, environment variable values, or any files, and performs no further network activity. Callback domain: hxxp://ngp-ui.auth-client.oob.jr0ch17[.]com (DNS, port 53).
